response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) as bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as benchmark_value
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(m.avg_unit_price),
  AVG(m.bytes_per_ms),
  AVG(m.bytes_per_ms - b.benchmark_value)
FROM media_type_stats m
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > b.benchmark_value;

assumptions.assumption: The bytes-per-millisecond figure for each media type is the simple average of per-track ratios (Bytes/Milliseconds), not the aggregate ratio (sum of bytes / sum of milliseconds).

alternatives.interpretation: The bytes-per-millisecond figure for each media type is the aggregate ratio: the total bytes summed across all tracks in that media type, divided by the total milliseconds summed across those tracks.
